req_name: Verify that Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) is enabled for accessing developer laptops and critical systems
Verify that all identities (human and programmatic) are managed through a centralized Identity Provider (IdP)
Verify all tools in documented software pipeline follow access permission as it relates to principle of least privilege
Verify that stale identities are disabled or removed after a predetermined period of inactivity
Verify service account tokens are reviewed for over-permissioning in both VCS and pipeline tool/secret store
Verify Version Control System requires MFA for all users
Verify Quarterly audit on Version Control System administrators
Verify that secrets are encrypted both at rest and in transit
Verify Endpoint Protection is running
Verify Endpoint Protection is set to routinely update
Verify Full Disk encryption is setup and enabled on developer laptops
Verify Patch Management is setup and enabled on developer laptops
Verify that developer machines are configured to lock automatically after a period of inactivity
Verify that the applicable controls from the relevant CIS Benchmark for OS hardening are in place.
Verify a documented software pipeline exists
Verify established Secure Development policy covers at minimum OWASP Top 10 pipeline Security Risks
Verify established Secure OSS policy
Verify established Security Policy related to Secrets/Credentials
Verify developer have reviewed Secure Development policy, specifically as it pertains to OWASP Top 10 pipeline Security Risks
Verify a company approved IDE/code writing tool is used and up-to-date
Verify IDE/code writing tool Plugin/s meet company policy and are approved
Verify developer IDE/code writing tool plugins are routinely updated
Verify that developer tools are configured to use secure communication protocols (e.g. HTTPS)
Verify that developer tools are monitored for unauthorized changes or usage
Verify a Version Control System is used that implements RBAC
Verify a .gitignore file is present to prevent commit of possible sensitive data or files
Verify Version Control System enforces branch schema to help with tracking vulnerability remediation
Verify secure coding OSS policy enforcement as it pertains to pipelines
Verify monthly Linting scans are conducted
Verify monthly Linting scan detections are remediated
Verify monthly Style scans are conducted
Verify monthly Style scan detections are remediated
Verify that unit tests cover security-related code paths
Verify that code quality tools are configured to flag insecure coding patterns

Verify code review policy to ensure that commits requires a security code review. 
- Consider cases where reviews by more than 1 person is required.
Verify code reviews are conducted where required as per security code review policy
Verify first party code security tool conducting monthly security scans on production repositories
Verify first party code security tool is on the latest version
Verify first party code security tool is updated monthly when scanning
Verify 3rd party code security tool conducting monthly scans on production repositories
Verify 3rd party code security tool is on the latest version
Verify 3rd party code security tool is updated at least monthly when scanning
Verify Secrets Detection tool conducting monthly scans on critical repositories
Verify Secrets Detection tool is on the latest version
Verify Secrets Detection tool is consistently updated when scanning
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool conducting monthly scans on production repositories
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool is on the latest version
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool is updated at least monthly when scanning
Verify that Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools are configured to enforce security policies
Verify that third-party libraries are regularly scanned for known vulnerabilities
Verify that third-party libraries are updated promptly when security patches are released
Verify that security Pre-Commit scans take place to detect security related issues before being committed
Verify that credentials are not hardcoded in code repositories or pipeline configuration files
Verify that all dependencies are fetched from trusted sources and verified against known hashes
Verify that dependency versions are pinned to avoid dependency confusion attacks
Verify that security unit tests are used as part of the development process.
Verify that unit tests are automated and run on every code change
Verify that build servers are hardened and regularly patched
Verify that access to build servers is restricted to authorized personnel only
Verify that build servers are monitored for unauthorized access attempts
Verify that build systems are hardened according to the guidelines for the specific platform or industry guidelines where available.
Verify that build systems are regularly reviewed for security misconfigurations
Verify there are no hardcoded secrets used during pipeline execution instead using secure pipeline environment variables
Verify that the pipeline uses built-in credential management or a secrets manager, rather than hard-coding credentials.
Verify only authorized users can view pipeline used secrets
Verify secrets are hidden and not exposed in pipeline logging files
Verify secrets are only used for integration and not used in production or other stages
Verify secret rotation is implemented and secrets rotated as it complies with secrets policy
Verify first party code security tool conducting monthly security scans on production repositories
Verify first party code security tool is on the latest version
Verify first party code security tool is updated monthly when scanning
Verify 3rd party code/Open Source Software security tool conducting monthly scans on production repositories
Verify 3rd party code/Open Source Software security tool is on the latest version
Verify 3rd party code/Open Source Software security tool is updated at least monthly when scanning
Verify Secrets Detection tool conducting monthly scans on critical repositories
Verify Secrets Detection tool is on the latest version
Verify Secrets Detection tool is consistently updated when scanning
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool conducting monthly scans on production repositories
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool is on the latest version
Verify security Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tool is updated at least monthly when scanning
Verify that Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools are configured to enforce security policies
Verify that dynamic security testing tool/s are used to scan running applications
Verify that automated security scans are run during the integration of new code
Verify that integration tests include security test cases to detect vulnerabilities early
Verify that security testing and evaluation are integrated into the CI process
Verify that branch protection rules are enforced on all repositories
Verify that auto-merge rules are restricted and reviewed for security implications
Verify that pipelines require manual approval for sensitive operations
Verify that build artifacts are cryptographically signed
Verify that checksums are used to validate the integrity of build artifacts before deployment
Verify that comprehensive security assessments have taken place on the release candidate aligned with security policy
Verify that pipeline-related policies are formally documented, maintained as compliance artifacts, and reviewed periodically for accuracy and relevance.
Verify that automated deployment scripts are used to minimize human error
Verify that deployment scripts are reviewed for security vulnerabilities and adhere to change control best practices and company policy.
Verify that secure transfer protocols are used during deployment

Verify that configuration information is secured in production using a secrets manager (e.g., Vault, AWS Secrets Manager). If encrypted config files are used instead, ensure encryption keys are stored separately in a secure service (e.g., KMS, HSM).
Verify that production environments are isolated from development and testing environments
Verify that deployment scripts include checks for unauthorized changes before execution
Verify that regular audits are conducted on users
Verify that access logs are maintained and reviewed periodically
Verify that privileged access management is implemented and monitored
Verify that security policies and standards are continuously enforced in the production environment
Verify that operational practices are regularly reviewed to ensure they do not compromise security
Verify that patches and updates are applied in a timely manner
Verify that real-time monitoring tools generate pipeline security logs and detect anomalies.
Verify that pipeline security logs are routinely reviewed and analyzed for anomalies not automatically detected.
Verify that pipeline security alerts are reviewed and responded to in a timely manner.
Verify that incident response plans are developed, maintained, and include procedures specific to pipeline security incidents.
Verify that incident response plans are tested regularly to ensure effectiveness
Verify that recovery procedures are tested and effective in minimizing downtime for pipelines
